name: Fraser fir
desc: Grows near the highest summits. The balsam woolly adelgid killed most mature firs from the 1960s on, though young firs are regrowing on some peaks.
about: Abies fraseri, commonly known as Fraser's fir, or Fraser fir, is an endangered species of fir in the order Pinales native to the Appalachian Mountains of the southeastern United States.
